steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize the Modern Calculator directory tree structure and create basic configuration files.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper Gradle 8.5, Java 17, and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 dependencies.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml file with correct package metadata, launcher activity, and standard icons.

steps.title: Design Round Button Drawables
steps.description: Create reusable shape and selector drawable XML definitions for functional, number, and operator buttons.

steps.title: Configure Application Values and Colors
steps.description: Establish standard system and custom values including dynamic color schemes for our immersive UI interface.

steps.title: Design Layout Structure
steps.description: Develop a sleek multi-row Grid/Linear hybrid calculator layout optimized for all screen sizes and display types.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Parser Logic
steps.description: Develop a custom expression calculator engine in Java 8 utilizing operator precedence without any external packages.

steps.title: Implement Sliding History Log
steps.description: Create robust sliding history log feature within MainActivity to track past calculations and allow users to restore equations.

steps.title: Wire Application Event Handlers
steps.description: Connect button click listeners, dynamic output scrolling, and direct haptic click feedback across layout buttons.

steps.title: Perform Strict Verification Checks
steps.description: Verify XML Android namespace specifications, absolute relative structures, and clean resource dependencies.

steps.title: Run Lint and Optimization Tests
steps.description: Optimize resource imports and double-check target compilation bounds to ensure target compatibility checks are clean.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Trigger debug build suite to compile resources, manifest components, logic files and package into final target package.
